In Jasper County, Game Warden Boone responds to a venomous rattlesnake. And, game wardens investigate the illegal killing of a goose in the Texas Panhandle.
Dr. Jeff has been helping pets around the world for 30 years. He remembers some of the most special, inspiring and important cases he has taken on.
Dr. Jeff treats a dog after it jumped from a fast-moving car on the highway. Plus, a couple of rescue guinea pigs cause a stir around the office.
Lizzy tries to track down the owner of a dog tied up outside the rescue centre. Plus, an older couple come looking for their first dog.
Two strays lead Lizzy and Villalobos staff on a wild goose chase. A grandmother comes in looking for another canine companion, but her dog Daisy has other plans.
Mayday! Mayday! Jackson gets his most vicious feline attack in years, at the claws of troubled cat, May. Plus, he helps a nervous wreck of a guardian move her feral cats to Canada.
Jackson works with hyperactive Persian cat Mr. Weasley, but when he collapses mid-play, the story takes a different turn. Plus, can he bring exiled cat Max back indoors.
Pete builds a barnlike birdhouse for two retirees on their Wisconsin farm. He designs three luxury pods and a deck overlooking their stable of alpacas.
Monkey Boo has free reign of the house and his owner's heart and Duke, a Labradoodle, is obsessed with getting into anything that might contain food.
Experts test to see if wild wolves are smarter than domestic dogs with an interesting experiment. Plus, can spiders really fly? And, how do polar bears keep warm.
Experts look at why ants don't drown. Why don't woodpeckers get headaches? And, how does a 15-foot octopus escape through a three-inch hole.
Shaun battles high winds to get a loveable cat named Tigger, a repeat offender, back down to his family once again. Plus, Tom comes to the rescue of Fritter.
Shaun learns the hard way that 'Cake' isn't as sweet as his name implies when he tries to reunite this skittish cat with its owners.
It's late fall and the Browns kickstart their ambitious cabin build. Plus, the family attempts to organise an extreme wedding in the mountains.
Howie Mandel wants ATM to build another tank! This time it's a surprise for his manager's company - and their an existing tank needs a major upgrade.

The paranormal team is called in to a haunted home after a little girl is attacked by an invisible entity. But are these spirits too powerful to expel.
The team is in Modimolle, South Africa, to find the mighty whip scorpion. This shape-shifting arachnid is one of the world's most gifted nocturnal predators.
The guys are in Manambato, Madagascar, to track down the tomato frog. One of the world's most remarkable ambush predators, it can dig into the ground in seconds.
The staff hope for a successful breeding season when Mshangao the giraffe meets the herd's females. Power tools are needed for an Amur tiger's root canal.

A tantrum-prone cat lives in fear of the other two cats living in the same home. Plus, Jackson tutors a bouncer on how to handle his sweet Tasmanian devil of a cat.
This hilarious and heart-warming look at everyday life with man's best friend explores the bonds we share with these adorable bundles of fur whether they're a mutt or a purebred.
A previous customer is back, asking for an even bigger and better tank. And, the guys build a custom acrylic waterfall for a memorial in Las Vegas.
Investigator McHugh does her best to dodge traffic trying to save a dog that's strayed onto a motorway. Later, she helps a Chihuahua with a spinal injury.
Investigator AJ swoops to save the pups of a dog that has given birth in an alley. Elsewhere, an animal medical technician pleads for the life of an injured bird.
Robert gets set to swim with Gloria, a huge reticulated python, for the first time in the Crocoseum. Plus, Bindi welcomes home two orphaned kangaroo joeys.
A Pennsylvania prison offers to take 20 dogs from Villalobos. An emaciated pit bull that was left on the side of the road fights for its life.
Jackson visits a blind cat suffering in a chaotic living environment. He then meets cat, Jude, who is a darling during the day - but a nightmare at night.
Jackson helps a couple afraid to have a child due to their hostile cat, Martini. And can he keep the peace between cats Tana and Buddha, who fight around the kitty litter.
Wardens Herchman and Stapleton join forces to track down a man who has faked his own death. And, a jet skier's life is spared after an explosion.
Tigger the cat is monitored closely for unusual eating habits. Plus, Dr. Jeff cautions an owner of the perils of buying online when she brings in her unwell puppy.
The crew is at an alpaca farm to build a lodge inspired by US National Parks. They create a structure with mountain views and cable bridge entrance.
White sharks are infiltrating the waters off Cape Cod. Greg Skomal joins Kina Scollay in New Zealand to test new technology for shark detecting surveillance.
This Christmas, it's the first-ever couples' Secret Santa. And this year, the Kilchers film themselves making inventive homemade gifts.
The Browns kick off an ambitious plan. Bear and the siblings throw caution to the wind on a critical first project disassembling and transporting a 50-foot windmill.
After a shadowy figure appears in their flat, a couple explore the history of their home. In the 1900s dying patients were housed there - are the deceased back.
